items.headline: FAA ground stop live updates: Flight cancellations continue into Monday
items.detail: The administrator said the ground stop was the result of equipment failure.

items.headline: Apple launches an AI health tool as part of a research study
items.detail: On Sunday, Apple announced a new approach, launching the Apple Health AI Usage Study app that they say will answer health questions only using trusted medical research.

items.headline: WATCH: Passenger jet collides with UPS plane on taxiway at Miami International Airport
items.detail: A UPS cargo plane and a Copa Airlines passenger jet collided on a taxiway at Miami International Airport on Saturday night, according to airport officials and the FAA.
